core: Amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation control
name: Lipoprotein-signaling control of amyloid-beta and glial activation
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation and clearance, apoptotic-cell and membrane uptake, and restraint of microglia/astrocytes; unlike the confusables, the theme includes lipoprotein particle signaling and oxidised-LDL responses rather than microglial proliferation, migration or cytotoxicity.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: All members cover the erythroid-megakaryocytic branch of haematopoiesis (megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis, erythrocyte differentiation and their RUNX1/TAL1-GFI1B control), distinguishing it from myeloid-progenitor/granulopoiesis themes and from a late-erythroid-only theme.

core: Viral attachment and host cell entry
name: Envelope glycoprotein-mediated viral attachment and host entry
rationale: Members describe receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and envelope-driven cell-cell fusion across RSV, influenza, dengue and HIV, unlike confusables centred on regulation of entry, virus transport or viral protein maturation.

name: Regulation of primary and precursor miRNA processing
rationale: All three members regulate processing of pri- and pre-miRNAs, whereas confusables cover miRNA biogenesis as a whole, RISC assembly, miRNA-mediated silencing or miRNA degradation.

core: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport
name: Carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover disaccharide digestion, intestinal hexose absorption and glucose/galactose/fructose transporters and their defects, distinguishing it from galactose/fructose catabolism and urate-transport confusables.

qualifier: cellular senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53-driven senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members span p53/p21/p16-ARF control of oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence (SAHF, SASP) and p53-transcribed intrinsic apoptosis (PUMA, NOXA); senescence distinguishes it from the broad apoptosis and G2-checkpoint confusables.

name: Histone and DNA methylation in heterochromatin silencing and imprinting
rationale: Members are histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, DNA/CpG methylation and their outputs (X inactivation, imprinting, facultative heterochromatin), unlike confusables built on CHD/NuRD remodelling or RUNX1/E2F6 co-factors.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitochondrial RNA stability
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and decay, distinguishing it from mtDNA replication/repair and mitochondrial translation/ribosome assembly confusables.

name: TNF-receptor-driven canonical and non-canonical NF-kB regulation
rationale: Members regulate IKK/NIK activation, linear ubiquitination and NF-kB transcription factor activity downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors, unlike confusables centred on B/T-cell receptor or TLR-TAK1/IRF NF-kB activation.

name: Inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: All three members concern synthesis of inositol phosphates and diphosphoinositol polyphosphates, unrelated to the nucleotide and PTEN/PI3K confusables.

name: Immunoglobulin diversification and stimulated CD4 T-cell division
rationale: Members combine B-cell commitment, V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and class switching with proliferation modules of stimulated CD4 T cells; the T-cell division members are what separate it from APOBEC/HIV and mismatch-repair confusables.

name: Bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal side-chain oxidation
rationale: Members cover cholesterol hydroxylation routes to bile acids and the peroxisomal/mitochondrial beta-oxidation that shortens the sterol side chain, distinguishing it from bile acid transport, recycling and intestinal lipid absorption confusables.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC carriers moving neutral amino acids, cystine, proline/glycine and urate across plasma membranes and their renal transport disorders, unlike confusables centred on oligopeptide, hexose or organic cation transport.

name: Regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein degradation
rationale: Members up- and down-regulate ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal proteolysis and protein destabilization, distinguishing it from confusables on protein folding/stabilization, ERAD and degron pathways or stress granules.

name: Nucleosome remodeling during DNA replication and repair
rationale: Members cover replication-dependent chromatin assembly, repair-dependent remodelling, nucleosome disassembly and CHD1/2 and ADP-ribosylation regulation, unlike confusables centred on BAF/NuRD complexes and histone acetylation or methylation.

name: Ferroptosis regulation and responses to ischemia and peroxides
rationale: Members concern iron-dependent ferroptosis, peroxide and hydrogen sulfide responses, ischemia and oxygen-glucose deprivation, distinguishing it from confusables focused on respiration control, nitrosative stress or ROS detoxification.

name: Calcium-CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium to CaMK/AMPK and adenylate cyclase-driven CREB phosphorylation, LTP/LTD and memory, unlike confusables centred on PKA/MECP2, structural plasticity or NMDA receptor gating.

name: B-vitamin cofactor metabolism and pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion
rationale: Members cover thiamine, riboflavin and pantothenate/CoA synthesis and transport together with the PDH reaction they serve, distinguishing it from cobalamin/biotin, lipoylation/OGDH and NAD confusables.

name: cGAS-STING control of interferon-beta and CCL5 production
rationale: Members regulate cGAS/STING signaling, cGAMP import, TREX1, interferon-beta and CCL5 production and dendritic-cell cytokines, unlike confusables centred on RIG-I/TLR sensing or type I interferon-stimulated effector genes.

name: Epithelial adherens junction assembly and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin-based adherens junction assembly and maintenance, apical-basal polarity and apical constriction, distinguishing it from desmosome/cardiac adhesion and CDH1-trafficking confusables.

qualifier: migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation, matrix adhesion and dedifferentiation within vessel remodeling and endothelial activation, unlike confusables centred on smooth muscle differentiation, apoptosis and phenotypic switching.

name: OTU deubiquitinase K48/K11 chain removal and PKR signaling
rationale: Members concern OTU-family removal of K48/K11 ubiquitin chains and its regulation, plus PKR kinase signaling, which is what separates it from K63/USP/metalloprotease deubiquitinase confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, integrin-mediated migration and neutrophil/T-cell diapedesis, distinguishing it from monocyte-activation, PECAM1/integrin-activation and shear-stress confusables.

name: Regulation of metanephric kidney development and size
rationale: All three members regulate metanephric kidney development and overall kidney size, unlike confusables on nephron/tubule differentiation, ureteric bud and duct formation or cell proliferation.

name: Endoplasmic reticulum tubular network organization
rationale: All three members concern forming and organizing the tubular ER membrane network, unlike confusables on organelle transport along microtubules or ER lipid transfer.
